title: A Wreck for the Monsoon
author: Isandro Ashgrove
blurb: Jude Underhill, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
